title: Ventilated Patients
Care
hero.text: Specialised care for patients who require respiratory support, mechanical ventilation, critical monitoring or step-down care after ICU admission.

overview: Ventilated patients care at Cambridge Hospital provides specialised support for patients with complex respiratory needs following critical illness or prolonged hospitalisation. This is one of the most clinically demanding areas of long-term care, requiring close coordination between physicians, respiratory therapists, nursing teams, rehabilitation professionals and case managers.

Our ventilated care model is designed not only to maintain clinical stability, but also to optimise function, reduce complications, and, where possible, support patients in reducing their dependence on mechanical ventilation or transitioning to another level of care.
